messages:
Olivia: Heads-up: planning a short internal announcement for the 1.8.0 runtime/model pin rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final internal note + whos standby for rollback.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: rollout ID r-2026-03-23-09. Canary -> phased -> global. Please set embargo if needed.

Maria: Draft is live at https://rwd.co/s/1.8.0-internal-draft. Key points: pinned model v2.4-internal, runtime jitter fixes, cost/batching tweaks. Can someone check the customer-impact line?

Priya: Customer-impact: no expected downtime. Recommend: "no customer-visible changes; internal pinning only". Avoid model-specifics for outward-facing comms.

Olivia: Agree. Internally we can call out v2.4 and the exact routes affected: model-host, router, and batcher. Public note will be generic.

Ashok: I'll own rollback for serving. Proposed rollback trigger: sustained 5xx >= 0.4% for 5m OR latency p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m. Rollback target: v1.8.0 -> v1.7.3. Rollback command ready: `./ops/rollback r-2026-03-23-09 --to v1.7.3`

deploy-bot: Canary health checks: require 3/4 green signals in first 12m. Auto-stop + page if failing. Alerts go to #eng-oncall and #incidents.

Julian: I'll prep quick dashboards (latency, 5xx, GPU mem) and add `release=1.8.0` tag to traces. Also will set GPU OOM alert at 82%.

Maria: Ops blurb suggestion: include step-by-step rollback in the note and a short verification checklist (smoke tests + 1 sample customer query). Link runbook: https://rwd.co/runbooks/release-rollback.

Olivia: Can we embargo 08:45-10:30 PT? Want to block unrelated infra pushes and ensure quiet window.

deploy-bot: Embargo set by @Olivia for 08:45-10:30 PT. Non-urgent pushes will be blocked within that window.

Priya: Standby roster: @Ashok (serving rollback), @Julian (infra), @Maria (SRE). I'll handle comms post-deploy in #all-hands at 08:55 PT.

Ashok: Note for runbook: include `slack notify` command for incidents and `deployctl status --id r-2026-03-23-09` for quick checks. Also recommend adding canary-weight label to metrics dashboard.

Julian: I'll upload mini-dashboards 10min before go for quick filter by `release=1.8.0` and `rollout=canary`.

Maria: Final internal note draft: "Tomorrow 09:00 PT we will roll 1.8.0 (model-host + runtime fixes). Brief canary window will run; no customer-facing downtime expected. Standby roster: Ashok, Julian, Maria. Rollback criteria and runbook linked. See internal doc: https://rwd.co/s/1.8.0-internal-draft". Ok to post at 08:55?

Olivia: Post at 08:55 sounds good. Remember to avoid public model/version details in external copy. Everyone good with embargo and rollback thresholds?

Priya: All good from comms side. I'll queue the internal post and pin in #eng-releases. :white_check_mark:

Ashok: I'll be monitoring the canary and ready to run rollback if triggers hit.

Julian: If anything changes, I'll update dashboards and shout in this thread.

Olivia: Thanks team 64f. See you tomorrow morning.
